mentions.name: bepr
mentions.description: A tool that allows shell access to hosts behind NAT/Wifi through a server over outbound WebSocket, using the exact same package for client, server, and user. It has a minimal 2MB binary footprint and wraps as a systemd/launchd service.
mentions.problem: Accessing a home setup while traveling without exposing hosts to the internet.
mentions.audience: Accessing one's own home machines remotely while traveling without exposing any hosts to the internet.
mentions.source_excerpt: bepr: https://github.com/Aperocky/bepr. This allow shell access to your hosts behind NAT/Wifi with a server over outbound websocket, all by using the exact same package for client + server + user. Minimal footprint at 2mb binary size and wrapped as systemd/launchd service.
